title: HOLD-LC-001 primary Stachie finite association implementation crosswalk
question: Does the primary Stachie et al. implementation paper provide enough explicit finite statistical semantics to advance the HOLD-LC-001 owner intake without treating its finite search prior or ranking statistic as a continuous physical timing likelihood?
method: Read arXiv:2001.01462v2 and its PDF as the primary implementation source cited by P1900186, recording the immutable version and bounded page/line locators.

Extract only source-reported implementation choices: trigger thresholds, GBM search windows, LLR selection, competing hypotheses, Lambda factorization, Q_L and Q_G distributions, time and sky overlap terms, and the time-shifted background procedure.

Compare those fields with the hash-pinned HOLD-LC-001 candidate-neutral Delta_t_det and response-owner contracts; keep finite retrospective search objects separate from pulse-onset, propagation, covariance, nuisance and prospective fields.

Run a five-axis adversarial review covering prior-versus-physics, ranking-versus-likelihood, KDE-versus-covariance, background-versus-holdout and method replacement; append this decision before reporting the route as advanced.

exact_scope.finite_scope: Primary-source finite association-search implementation semantics only; no event-level response values, pulse reconstruction, continuous timing likelihood, covariance, candidate map, score, limit or prospective validation.
exact_scope.method_scope: Additive T-061 P1 source-owner intake refinement; T-054 forward method, T-059 inverse method, owner order and stopped-loop rules are unchanged.

official_source.title: Search for Advanced LIGO Single Interferometer Compact Binary Coalescence Signals in Coincidence with Gamma-Ray Events in Fermi-GBM
official_source.source_scope: Primary implementation description; arXiv abstract reports a general single-detector GW--GBM pairing method and no significant candidates, while the PDF supplies the finite statistic and calibration details.

trigger_and_selection: The GW input is a PyCBC single-interferometer trigger with reweighted SNR rho_hat_gw >= 8.
The GBM Targeted Search examines +/-30 s around the GW time on timescales from 0.256 s to 8.192 s.
For each time window the GBM log-likelihood ratio is evaluated and only the highest-LLR window with LLR >= 5 is retained.
hypotheses: HC: GW and GBM contain signals from a common source.
HNN, HSN, HNS and HSS: the four logical alternatives containing noise and/or unrelated signals.

joint_statistic.source_formula: Lambda = I_Delta_t * I_Omega / (1 + Q_L + Q_G + Q_L * Q_G)
joint_statistic.time_overlap: Delta_t = t_EM - t_GW, where t_EM is the center of the maximum-LLR GBM window and t_GW is the estimated GW merger time
joint_statistic.sky_overlap: I_Omega = integral P(Omega | D_L) P(Omega | D_G) / P(Omega) dOmega with uniform P(Omega) = 1/(4 pi)

finite_time_prior.source_interpretation: Equal GW and EM propagation speed is assumed, but the intrinsic source emission offset is not fully known; the paper calls the shape a search choice and notes other similar finite shapes would be reasonable.

distribution_and_calibration.gbm: Real-signal and O2-background LLR histograms are KDE-fitted over source-specified ranges and use an LLR^-4 high-tail convention above the KDE range.
distribution_and_calibration.gw: L1/H1 and O1/O2 rho_hat_gw distributions are histogram/KDE based with source-reported thresholds and a rho_hat_gw^-4 high-tail convention.
distribution_and_calibration.background: The same GBM configuration is run on a 23-day interval, GBM triggers are shifted by nonzero integer multiples of 50 s, and the resulting Lambda distribution is normalized by total coincident live time to obtain FAR.

partial_fields_supported: Finite GBM signal-versus-background LLR definition and maximum-LLR selection.
Finite competing-hypothesis and joint Bayes-factor/ranking formula.
Finite time-overlap prior and sky-overlap integral.
Versioned trigger thresholds, histogram/KDE distribution roles and high-tail conventions.
A reproducible retrospective time-shifted background-to-FAR protocol.
not_supported_for_hold_lc_001_admission: An event-level pulse-onset estimator tied to the frozen GBM response products.
A continuous Delta_t_det likelihood with detector-to-geocenter propagation and uncertainty.
Response-segment validity/interpolation, gain calibration and response-matrix uncertainty.
A joint covariance including GW merger time, GBM onset/background, calibration and shared source terms.
An intrinsic-emission-lag nuisance model or preregistered set-valued physical scorer.
A sealed prospective holdout or complete F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map.

checks.detail: The arXiv v2 primary paper is the implementation cited by P1900186 and is pinned by versioned URL and PDF locators.
The paper explicitly defines the competing hypotheses, Lambda factorization, Q_L/Q_G factors, time and sky overlap terms, trigger thresholds and background calibration procedure.
The paper advances finite statistical-owner semantics but does not fill event response, propagation, covariance, intrinsic-lag or prospective fields required for HOLD-LC-001.
The published search implementation and its fitted background distributions remain retrospective provenance; no candidate or holdout credit is assigned.
The established T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods, source-owner order and stopped-loop registry are unchanged.

finding: The primary Stachie et al. implementation materially advances the statistical-owner intake. It specifies the finite trigger selection, competing hypotheses, joint Lambda formula, source-reported Q_L/Q_G distribution construction, triangular time prior, sky-overlap integral and time-shifted FAR calibration. These fields make the finite association-search method reproducible in principle, but they do not supply the event-specific GBM response/propagation owner, continuous pulse-onset likelihood, covariance, intrinsic-lag nuisance law or prospective map. The branch is therefore advanced as a finite source-statistic candidate with admission stopped.
decision_reason: This is a new primary implementation source that fills previously unspecified finite statistical semantics and narrows the exact owner request. It is not a repeated generic blocker and does not alter the forward or inverse proof methods.
decision_scope: T0 primary finite retrospective statistical crosswalk only; no event likelihood, dynamic identification, physical identity or empirical prediction.
assumptions: arXiv:2001.01462v2 is the intended primary implementation version cited by the joint-search paper.
Source-reported thresholds, priors, KDE ranges, tail conventions and shifts are recorded as implementation choices and not independently re-derived constants.
The local HOLD-LC-001 estimator and response-owner contracts remain controlling for continuous timing and physical-owner admission.
The triangular I_Delta_t term is a finite search prior and cannot be reused as an intrinsic-emission-lag law without a separate owner.
missing_assumptions: Versioned event-level GBM inputs and a reproducible pulse estimator linked to the selected response products.
Source-owned response validity/interpolation, gain calibration and detector-to-geocenter conversion with uncertainty.
A common timing covariance or likelihood for GW merger time, GBM onset/background, calibration and shared-source terms.
A source-owned intrinsic-emission-lag nuisance model or preregistered set-valued scorer.
A sealed prospective holdout and independently reproduced F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map.

adversarial_review.check: Could the triangular time-overlap term be promoted to the physical source emission-lag law?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: it is documented as a finite search choice under incomplete intrinsic-offset knowledge, not a measured physical lag distribution.

adversarial_review.check: Could Lambda be inserted as the continuous HOLD-LC-001 Delta_t_det likelihood?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: Lambda combines finite trigger-statistic factors and overlap terms and does not define pulse, response or propagation likelihood.

adversarial_review.check: Could the KDE fits and power-law tails supply the missing calibration or covariance budget?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: they model retrospective trigger-statistic distributions and do not decompose response, timing or shared-source uncertainty.

adversarial_review.check: Could the 23-day time-shifted background be credited as a prospective holdout for a new candidate scorer?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: it calibrates the published retrospective search statistic and is not sealed before a new scorer or candidate is frozen.

adversarial_review.check: Could the implementation paper replace the established T-054 or T-059 method?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: this is an additive T-061 source-owner candidate and preserves the existing methods and owner order.

boundary: EXP-001311 is a T0 primary finite statistical-method crosswalk. It does not admit a continuous HOLD-LC-001 likelihood, covariance, detector-to-geocenter implementation, response value, calibration-validity rule, intrinsic-lag nuisance law, F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, candidate, score, prospective prediction, microscopic dynamics, physical identity, continuum result, Reading-H sign, Pre-A closure or mass-gap conclusion.
evidence_level: T0 primary implementation source with bounded formula and calibration extraction; no event-level numerical reproduction
next_action: Use the pinned Lambda implementation and time-shift protocol as a finite statistical-owner checklist. Seek versioned event-level code/data that binds GBM pulse extraction, rsp2 selection, calibration, detector-to-geocenter conversion and uncertainty; independently reproduce the finite statistic only after those inputs are frozen, and keep continuous scoring and prospective credit locked.
stop_or_redesign: If no versioned event inputs or implementation owner can be obtained, retain this record as finite method provenance and do not admit HOLD-LC-001.
If a later implementation changes the time prior, KDE/tail convention or background construction after target disclosure, version it anew and invalidate prospective use.
If continuous timing and covariance remain absent, report finite association evidence only rather than substituting Lambda for Delta_t_det.
If static-equivalent candidates remain indistinguishable under every admitted dynamic observable, report their equivalence class rather than selecting a representative.
non_claims: The Lambda implementation is not a continuous event-level Delta_t_det likelihood or covariance.
The triangular time prior is not an intrinsic-emission-lag law and the time-shifted background is not a prospective holdout.
No response matrix value, calibration-validity rule, detector-to-geocenter correction, candidate score or prospective map is admitted.
No microscopic dynamics, QFT/Yang--Mills/gravity identity, Pre-A, C6, A13, Sector-A, continuum, physical-vacuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything or mass-gap claim is established.
The established T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods are unchanged; this is an additive T-061 source-owner crosswalk.
